data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's prior underwriting years delivered a material net release in 2014. The primary quantitative source (analysis by year of account) shows a gross prior-year release of GBP 45.795m (approximately a 31% reduction versus opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 147.686m), driven by favourable claims development and improved outcomes on prior year claims settlements. The release is described in the narrative as an improvement on closed year reserves (figures of c.GBP 12.2m/GBP 12.9m are cited in parts of the report for specific closed-year improvements), while the year-by-year movement table provides the gross movement used here.
raw_causal_phrases: significant reserve releases from prior accident years

data.data_quality_notes: Primary gross prior-year movement taken from the 'Change in provision for gross claims' column for '2012 and Prior Years of Account' in the year-by-year analysis (45,795 GBP 000 => -45.795m release). The narrative elsewhere cites smaller closed-year improvements (e.g. GBP 12.2m and GBP 12.9m) - these relate to specific closed year(s) or different scopes; the table value used is the gross movement across 2012 & prior as reported. Some event amounts are reported in USD in the report; no currency conversion was performed, so event amounts are null here. No gross claims development triangle was present in the report to cross-check the PYD.
